AI insights quick analysis of the current picture
1
Data confidence is suppressing the performance pictureReporting gaps concentrate in two departments — the headline score may improve materially once outstanding updates land.
2
Weighting is skewing the strategic scoreA lower-weighted focus area is over-delivering while a higher-weighted one lags — consider whether resource allocation matches weighting.
3
Early-warning: consecutive-period slippageTwo indicators with healthy year-to-date scores have declined for 3 consecutive periods — review before the trend compounds.
Two clocks, never confused: in-year reporting movement, and the five-year strategic cycle. Cross-year comparison only where the measure is comparable.
1 · In-year reporting · {{trendLevelLabel}}
AOP monthly vs APP quarterly mean capped achievement
Update hygiene complete ÷ due · timeline shifts with level
{{hygieneLevel}} cadence: {{hygieneLevel=='SP'?'annual (Y1–Y5)':hygieneLevel=='APP'?'quarterly (Q1–Q4)':'monthly (Apr–Sep)'}}. The gap between delivery and hygiene is the "we don't know" zone.
2 · Five-year strategic cycle · SP with APP & AOP overlay
SP & APP annual performance Y1–Y2 actuals, Y3–Y5 planComparable
APP weighted annual performance is overlaid on the SP cycle to show whether annual delivery is tracking the five-year plan. Y2 dips on backlog (SPI4) and irregular expenditure (SPI7); Y3 in progress — the quarterly view drives the current picture.

Definitions and denominators
{{d.term}}
{{d.def}}
Reporting hierarchy, overrides and permissions
Derived level
Distance from the CEO. CEO = Level 0, a direct report to the CEO = Level 1, a direct report to Level 1 = Level 2, and so on recursively.
Override
reportingLevelOverride replaces the derived level for comparison purposes only; the administrative reporting line is unchanged. Overridden records carry an OVR badge in authorised detail views.
Employee
Own individual detail only. Organisation-wide aggregates are permitted where they clear the confidentiality threshold. BU, division and individual filters are disabled.
Line manager
Self plus every direct and indirect report. Never peers, never ancestors.
Division owner
Own record plus the complete reporting subtree below that owner.
Business Unit head
Every authorised division aggregate and individual in that Business Unit, including nested divisions.
Human Capital
All employees within the configured HR scope — the whole organisation in this prototype.
CEO
Entire organisation.
360° confidentiality
Groups with fewer than {{paCfg.minResponses}} non-self responses show Insufficient responses. Employees never see reviewer identities or reviewer-level scores.
Where access is applied
Row-level access runs before any aggregation, so hidden records cannot leak through totals, tooltips, legends, exports, search, comparison lists or drill-down counts.

{{d.id}}{{d.sheet}} {{d.severity}} {{d.issue}}{{d.handling}}
H1 / H2 / Full-year aggregation
Period records
Periods are explicit records carrying fiscalYear, periodCode, periodType, start, end, workflowStatus and weight. Behaviour is never inferred from a label.
Halves
H1 and H2 show their own contracting and 360° records only.
Full year
Weighted mean of eligible completed halves using the configured weights ({{paCfg.periodWeights.H1}}/{{paCfg.periodWeights.H2}}). Halves that are ineligible or unscored are excluded from the mean and named in the completeness warning.
Provisional results
Where only one half is complete the full-year result is shown with a visible completeness warning and a Provisional FY flag — never as a closed annual score.
360° full year
Mean of eligible H1 and H2 rounds for the same area and rater category. Kept entirely separate from the contract score.
Excluded answers
Incomplete and Not Applicable responses are excluded from averages and remain in completion denominators, following the existing SAFCOL 360° rules.

Business rulesBRL-01 to 09
RuleDescription
BRL-01A round may include multiple employees, but each individual 360° assessment relates to one employee.
BRL-02The rater categories are self, line manager, peer, colleague and subordinate.
BRL-03Where fewer or equal options exist than the minimum required, reviewers auto-allocate for employee approval.
BRL-04The reviewer cap and category minimums are applied during setup.
BRL-05Employees may view aggregated results only.
BRL-07The 360° result and the KPI result remain separately calculated.
BRL-09Release occurs only after the approved completion conditions are met and the manager has approved release.
